home.metaTitle: ArcanaKin — meetups, ranking and decks for your Magic group
home.metaDescription: Schedule your next Commander night: availability, meetups, games, ranking, decks with analysis and proxy sheets.

hero.title: The table comes together. ArcanaKin handles the rest.
hero.subtitle: Everyone marks when and where they can play. The app finds when the table comes together, records games, keeps the ranking and helps improve your decks.

intro.title: What is ArcanaKin
intro.body: A place for your Magic group to organize life away from the table: no more polls in the group chat, rankings in spreadsheets or lost decklists. It was born at a four-friend Commander table and is growing with help from players.
intro.name: The name blends arcana, the secrets of magic, and kin, your people: a home for your Magic family.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything your group needs, from the invite to the last game of the night.

availability.title: Availability and times
availability.body: Everyone marks the times and places they can play, once or weekly. The app shows when the table comes together and suggests the meetup.

events.title: Meetups
events.body: Create the meetup, RSVP, add it to your calendar (.ics) and share it on WhatsApp. Reminders and changes arrive by email.

games.title: Games in many formats
games.body: Commander, Brawl, Oathbreaker, Two-Headed Giant, Standard, Modern, Draft and more: winner or draw, teams, deck used, who went first and elimination order.

ranking.title: Ranking, seasons and stats
ranking.body: Group-defined points, seasons, head-to-head, win streaks, the decks and commanders that win most, and a searchable meetup history.

profiles.title: Profiles and achievements
profiles.body: Every player has a profile with a summary, season titles, achievement badges and the decks they choose to show.

decks.title: Decks with images
decks.body: Import from Archidekt, Moxfield or a pasted list, in the right format. Pick each card's printing, see both sides of double-faced cards and edit with Scryfall search.

proxies.title: Proxies and prices
proxies.body: Mark how many copies are proxies, print a real-size 3×3 sheet with cut marks and see the deck price in dollars and reais.

analysis.title: Deck analysis
analysis.body: A 0–100 score, card roles, estimated bracket, mana base, opening-hand odds, comparison with other decks of the same commander and swap suggestions.

mobile.title: Android and iOS app
mobile.body: In development: meetups, RSVPs, ranking and decks in your pocket, with Google sign-in.

sources.title: Where the data comes from
sources.subtitle: We only use sources that allow it and we credit them. What belongs to your group stays in your group.

scryfall.name: Scryfall
scryfall.body: Card data and images, printings, dollar prices, the Game Changers list, Scryfall Tagger roles and the EDHREC popularity rank published by Scryfall. Updated daily.

spellbook.name: Commander Spellbook
spellbook.body: The deck's combos and the cards that weigh on the bracket (mass land denial, extra turns).

bcb.name: Central Bank of Brazil
bcb.body: Official dollar rate (PTAX) to convert prices to reais.

importers.name: Archidekt and Moxfield
importers.body: Importing the public lists you point to, with the chosen printings.

links.name: LigaMagic and EDHREC
links.body: Links only, so you can check Brazilian prices and the commander page: their terms of use don't allow automated requests.

group.name: Your group
group.body: Availability, meetups and games are only seen by group members. Each deck can be private, group-only or public.

method.title: How we evaluate and suggest
method.subtitle: Simple rules, explained on screen. The analysis is a guide for talking with your table, not a verdict.

format.title: 1. Format first
format.body: Every deck has a format. Validation follows its rules: deck size, copies per card (adding up all printings), sideboard, commanders and partners (Partner, Partner with, Background, Character select…), color identity and the format's banned and restricted list (Scryfall data).

roles.title: 2. Card roles
roles.body: Ramp, draw, removal, wipe, tutor, protection, recursion and counterspell come from Scryfall Tagger. Cards not looked up yet are classified by reading their rules text, and the screen shows how many came from each source.

score.title: 3. A 0–100 score
score.body: In commander formats, the score adds six parts with community reference targets. Roles earn points proportionally up to the target; lands lose 3 points per card outside the range; the curve earns everything up to an average mana value of 3 and drops to zero at 4.5.

suggestions.title: 4. Suggestions and alternatives
suggestions.body: Missing lands or a role? The app says how many and looks for same-role alternatives on Scryfall, within the color identity, format and chosen mana value, most played first.

bracket.title: 5. Estimated bracket
bracket.body: Applies the objective rules of the official Commander brackets: Game Changers (none up to 2, up to three in 3), mass land denial, chained extra turns and two-card combos. The result is a minimum: intent and speed are for your table.

mana.title: 6. Mana base and opening hand
mana.body: Compares the lands producing each color with a target proportional to the mana symbols and uses the hypergeometric distribution to compute the odds of 2 to 4 lands in the opening hand and of hitting every land drop.

compare.title: 7. Comparison
compare.body: Shows the average of decks with the same commander on ArcanaKin that you can see, common cards you're missing and your own picks.

group.title: And in the group
group.body: Suggested times are the windows when at least a full table is free for the group's minimum duration. The ranking adds points for wins, draws and losses (3, 1 and 0 by default, adjustable by the group).

method.scoreCaption: How the 100 points of the score are split

accessible.title: Accessible to everyone
accessible.body: We follow WCAG 2.2 level AA: everything works with keyboard and screen readers, with proper contrast, in light and dark themes. Every new screen is audited before it ships.

privacy.title: Privacy and open data
privacy.body: We don't sell data. We only use sources that allow it, credit each one, and you decide who sees your decks.

join.title: Join the tests
join.body: ArcanaKin is being tested with Commander groups. Use it with your table and tell us what worked, what was missing and what broke: every message becomes an improvement.
